en: Romans 5

p.src: 1  Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

ja: イエス・キリストを通して、
en: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
u.src: 1  Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

p.src: 2  through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

ja: る道が開かれました。そして、
en: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
u.src: 2  through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

p.src: 3  Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

en: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
u.src: 3  Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

p.src: 4  and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

ja: むと知っているからです。
en: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;
u.src: 4  and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

p.src: 5  and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

en: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
u.src: 5  and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

p.src: 6  For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

en: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
u.src: 6  For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

p.src: 7  For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

ja: ぬ人は、ほとんどいません。
のうとする人がいるかもしれません。
en: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.
u.src: 7  For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

p.src: 8  But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

ja: であったとき、キリストが
んでくださったことによって、
en: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
u.src: 8  But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

p.src: 9  Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

ja: とされたのですから、この方を通して
en: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
u.src: 9  Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

p.src: 10  For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

en: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
u.src: 10  For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

p.src: 11  Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

ja: それだけではありません。
イエス・キリストによって
en: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
u.src: 11  Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

p.src: 12  Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.

ja: りました。こうして、すべての
en: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.
u.src: 12  Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.

p.src: 13  For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

ja: 界にありました。しかし、
en: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
u.src: 13  For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

p.src: 14  Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

ja: それでも、アダムからモーセまで、アダムの違反と同じような罪を犯さなかった人々に対してさえ、
en: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
u.src: 14  Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

p.src: 15  But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

ja: んだのであれば、なおさら、
en: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
u.src: 15  But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

p.src: 16  The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

ja: とは異なります。一人の罪から
くの違反を越えて、人を義とするものとなったからです。
en: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.
u.src: 16  The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

p.src: 17  For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

ja: したのであれば、なおさら、豊かな
イエス・キリストを通して、命のうちに王として
en: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
u.src: 17  For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

p.src: 18  So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

ja: つの違反によってすべての
が義とされて命を得るに
en: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
u.src: 18  So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

p.src: 19  For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

en: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
u.src: 19  For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

p.src: 20  The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

ja: わるためでした。しかし、
みがさらにあふれました。
en: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,
u.src: 20  The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

p.src: 21  that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

ja: イエス・キリストによる
en: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
u.src: 21  that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
